stem.en: A point in space near a fixed charge has an electric potential of 10 V, whether or not anything is placed there. What does this tell you?
stem.et: Kindla laengu läheduses olev ruumipunkt omab elektripotentsiaali 10 V, sõltumata sellest, kas sinna midagi on asetatud. Mida see näitab?

label.en: Potential is a property of the location itself, set by the source charge alone
label.et: Potentsiaal on asukoha enda omadus, mille määrab ainuüksi allika laeng

label.en: The point cannot really have a potential until a test charge is placed there
label.et: Punktil ei saa tegelikult potentsiaali olla, kuni sinna on katselaeng asetatud

label.en: Potential and potential energy must be the same 10 J at that point
label.et: Potentsiaal ja potentsiaalne energia peavad selles punktis olema sama 10 J

label.en: The value would change if a larger test charge were placed there instead
label.et: Väärtus muutuks, kui sinna asetataks hoopis suurem katselaeng
